data.name: About_Description
data.value: Monitors a UPS through a Network UPS Tools (NUT) server and shuts down the computer when the battery runs low.
data.comment: About window: one-line description of what Coco.Nut does. New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: About_Acknowledgements
data.comment: About window: heading above the short list of third-party libraries/projects Coco.Nut is built on or ported from. New in Coco.Nut. The list itself (library/project names) is shown as plain, untranslated text, like the native language names elsewhere in this file.

WinNUT built this by concatenating a bare 'Application shut down at' fragment with the timestamp; every imported translation below is manually adapted (in new_strings.csv) to use the {0} composite-format placeholder instead, reusing the same wording.

data.name: Shutdown_Reason_BatteryCharge
data.value: Battery charge {0}% is at or below the limit of {1}%.
data.comment: Shutdown window/log: why the shutdown procedure started (Power.BatteryChargeFloor). {0} = current charge %, {1} = configured floor %. New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Shutdown_Reason_Fsd
data.value: The NUT server requested a forced shutdown.
data.comment: Shutdown window/log: why the shutdown procedure started (Power.RespectFsd / FSD status flag). New in Coco.Nut; parallels the existing Log_ForcedShutdownByServer.

data.name: Shutdown_Reason_Runtime
data.value: Remaining runtime {0} is at or below the limit of {1}.
data.comment: Shutdown window/log: why the shutdown procedure started (Power.RuntimeFloorSeconds). {0} = current remaining runtime, {1} = configured floor, both pre-formatted by the caller (e.g. mm:ss). New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Shutdown_Reason_UpsLowBattery
data.value: The UPS reports a critical low-battery condition (ups.status contains OB and LB).
data.comment: Shutdown window/log: why the shutdown procedure started (ShutdownReason.UpsLowBattery - NUT's own OB+LB critical condition, which WinNUT did not check). New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Shutdown_Title
data.comment: Shutdown countdown window title.

data.name: StopAction_Hibernate
data.comment: Stop action option: hibernate the system.

data.name: StopAction_Shutdown
data.comment: Stop action option: shut the system down.

data.name: StopAction_Suspend
data.comment: Stop action option: suspend the system (WinNUT called this 'Sleep').

data.name: Tray_Menu_About
data.comment: System tray context menu: opens the About window.

data.name: Tray_Menu_CheckForUpdate
data.comment: System tray context menu: checks for a new Coco.Nut release.

data.name: Tray_Menu_Exit
data.comment: System tray context menu: exits the application. Distinct key from Common_Exit so the tray menu can be built/translated independently of other 'Exit' usages.

data.comment: System tray context menu: opens the Settings window.

data.name: Tray_Menu_Show
data.comment: System tray context menu: restores the main window. New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Tray_Tooltip
data.comment: System tray icon hover tooltip. {0} = UPS name, {1} = status text (e.g. one of the Main_Status_* strings). Not translated per culture: it is a plain two-value template, not natural-language text, so the English fallback is used everywhere. New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: UpdateChannel_PreRelease
data.comment: Update channel option: also include pre-releases (WinNUT called this 'Development').

data.name: UpdateChannel_Stable
data.comment: Update channel option: only stable releases.

data.name: UpdateInterval_Daily
data.comment: Settings > Update: update check interval option (AppSettings.UpdateSettings.AutoCheckIntervalDays = 1). No current WinNUT resx control uses this word, but WinNUT's Translation/*.csv master table still has it (from an older combo box option), so its translation is carried over via key_map.csv/new_strings.csv.

data.name: UpdateInterval_Monthly
data.comment: Settings > Update: update check interval option (AutoCheckIntervalDays = 30). See UpdateInterval_Daily.

data.name: UpdateInterval_Weekly
data.comment: Settings > Update: update check interval option (AutoCheckIntervalDays = 7, the default). See UpdateInterval_Daily.

data.name: Update_CheckFailed
data.comment: Shown when an update check fails (network error, bad response, ...). {0} = error message (UpdateCheckResult.Error). New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Update_Message
data.value: Version {0} is available. You are using version {1}.
data.comment: Update available window: headline. {0} = latest version, {1} = running version. New in Coco.Nut.

data.name: Update_NoUpdate
data.value: You are using the latest version.
data.comment: Shown (e.g. after a manual 'Check for updates') when no newer release was found. New in Coco.Nut; parallels the existing Log_NoUpdateAvailable log entry.

data.name: Update_PublishedDate

data.name: Validation_CalibrationMinLessThanMax
data.value: The minimum value must be less than the maximum value.
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: one Calibration.*Min value is not less than its *Max counterpart (input/output voltage, input frequency, load, battery voltage).

data.name: Validation_ChargeFloorRange
data.value: Battery charge floor must be between 0 and 100%.
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Power.BatteryChargeFloor outside 0-100.

data.name: Validation_DelayRange
data.value: Delay must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Power.StopDelaySeconds or Power.ExtendDelaySeconds outside 1-MaxDelaySeconds (3600).

data.name: Validation_HostRequired
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Connection.Host is empty/whitespace.

data.name: Validation_PollIntervalRange
data.value: Polling interval must be between 0.1 and 100 seconds.
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Connection.PollIntervalMs outside MinPollIntervalMs (100)-MaxPollIntervalMs (100 000) milliseconds.

data.name: Validation_PortRange
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Connection.Port outside 1-65535.

data.name: Validation_RuntimeFloorRange
data.value: Runtime floor must be between 0 and 3600 seconds.
data.comment: AppSettingsValidator: Power.RuntimeFloorSeconds outside 0-MaxDelaySeconds (3600).
